verdict.rationale: Smooth documents browser profiles that persist cookies and authentication across sessions. The docs say to log in once and reuse that authentication for future tasks, and this is covered in both the API docs and the CLI docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that profiles reliably skip login walls across runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist logged-in browser state in reusable profiles so agents skip the login wall on every subsequent run

citations.quote: Browser profiles allow you to persist cookies and authentication across sessions. Log in once, then reuse that authentication for future tasks.
Browser profiles save your login state so your agent can access authenticated content. Log in once manually, then your agent can work with that account indefinitely.
